_doc: Estilo fixo de TODAS as imagens do vídeo (Google Flow / Nano Banana). Preencha a partir de assets/style-bible.md. Prompts em inglês rendem melhor.
sufixo: Cinematic documentary still, painterly realism, soft volumetric light, rich but restrained palette of deep teal shadows and warm amber highlights, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, rule-of-thirds composition with breathing room around the subject for a slow zoom, no text.
negativos: text, letters, captions, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted faces, modern objects out of period, frame borders

cenarios.porto-noite: A crowded 19th-century harbor at night, gas lamps reflecting on wet cobblestones, sailing ships at the docks, dock workers carrying crates.
